_comment: Generic, instance-agnostic access scaffold shipped with the NTD package (NOT Sierra Leone accounts). Three roles (capabilities) + two groups (sharing targets). install.py imports these, then shares dashboards/visualizations/maps/indicator groups to the NTD Users group (view) and datasets + category options to the NTD Data Entry group (data capture). The shipped configuration stays STATIC for every non-superuser: no role has the Maintenance app or any metadata-create authority. Adopters create users and assign, per user, a role + group membership(s) + org-unit scope. The System Administrator is the existing instance superuser (not shipped). ESPEN Connector app access is a separate per-adopter step (see docs/setup.md). Role authorities use the classic M_dhis-web-* app names; verify them on your DHIS2 version.

userRoles.name: NTD Administrator
userRoles.description: National programme / M&E: view all dashboards, enter national datasets, run validation, export (incl. dependency JSON), build own visualizations. Cannot edit the shipped configuration (no Maintenance, no metadata-create authorities).

userRoles.name: NTD Data Entry
userRoles.description: Enter/edit data for the org units in the user's scope; view dashboards. No configuration editing.

userRoles.name: NTD Viewer
userRoles.description: Read-only: view and download dashboards, visualizations, and maps. No data entry, no editing.
